results.title: Nigeria and Ethiopia: What rail and road comparisons leave out
results.snippet:
Make the railway earn its place  
 Nigeria is rebuilding a railway that suffered deep decay. Calling it dead conveys the damage, though it had not vanished entirely. We must renew the assets, train the workforce, protect the service and persuade customers that it can be trusted. There are assets to build on. NRC runs Lagos–Ibadan, Abuja–Kaduna and Warri–Itakpe services.
